messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Parallel mediation with exogenous categorical manifest vars
parts: tell me if the theoretical model below is doable in lavaan

The only stumbling block is that lavaan does not implement any appropriate distributions for count outcomes (e.g., Poisson or negative binomial) like Mplus does.  I expect you could consider treating the count outcome as though it were ordered, if your diagram accurately states that the counts are only in the set 1:6.  A multinomial/categorical distribution has more parameters than a Poisson (only lambda) or NB (an additional dispersion parameter), yet it would be more restrictive in the sense that it assumes 1:6 are the only possible values (whereas Poisson or NB would allow for predicted counts > 6 even if they were not observed).
given the use of categorical and binary variables as indicators of latent exogenous variables LV1 and LV2. If this is doable, would you use WLSMV estimator?

That is the default.  PML is another good estimator.
